mapper.insert: insert into riding_record (rr_idx, rr_rider, rr_distance, rr_topspeed, rr_avgspeed, rr_high, rr_gpx, rr_open, rr__breaktime, rr_time, rr_area, rr_name, rr_create_time, rr_duration_sec, rr_memo) values ( #{rr_num}, #{rr_rider}, #{rr_distance}, #{rr_topspeed}, #{rr_avgspeed}, #{rr_high}, #{rr_gpx}, #{rr_open}, #{rr_breaktime}, CURRENT_DATE, #{rr_area}, #{rr_name}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{rr_time}, #{rr_memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(case when rr_idx regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(rr_idx as unsigned) else 0 end), 0) + 1 from riding_record
mapper.sql: rr_weather_observed_at, rr_weather_nx, rr_weather_ny, rr_weather_temperature_c, rr_weather_sky_code, rr_weather_precipitation_code, rr_weather_precipitation_mm, rr_weather_label, rr_memo
mapper.select:
select cast(rr_idx as unsigned) as rr_num, rr_rider, rr_create_time as rr_date, rr_distance, rr_topspeed, rr_avgspeed, rr_high, rr_gpx, cast(coalesce(rr_open, '0') as unsigned) as rr_open, coalesce(rr__breaktime, 0) as rr_breaktime, coalesce(rr_duration_sec, 0) as rr_time, rr_area, rr_name,
from riding_record where rr_rider = #{rr_rider} and rr_idx regexp '^[0-9]+$' order by rr_create_time desc, cast(rr_idx as unsigned) desc

select cast(rr_idx as unsigned) as rr_num, rr_rider, rr_create_time as rr_date, rr_distance, rr_topspeed, rr_avgspeed, rr_high, rr_gpx, cast(coalesce(rr_open, '0') as unsigned) as rr_open, coalesce(rr__breaktime, 0) as rr_breaktime, coalesce(rr_duration_sec, 0) as rr_time, rr_area, rr_name,
from riding_record where rr_rider = #{rr_rider} and rr_idx = #{rr_num}

select cast(rr_idx as unsigned) as rr_num, rr_rider, rr_create_time as rr_date, rr_distance, rr_topspeed, rr_avgspeed, rr_high, rr_gpx, cast(coalesce(rr_open, '0') as unsigned) as rr_open, coalesce(rr__breaktime, 0) as rr_breaktime, coalesce(rr_duration_sec, 0) as rr_time, rr_area, rr_name,
from riding_record where rr_rider = #{rr_rider} and rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR)

select cast(rr_idx as unsigned) as rr_num, rr_rider, rr_create_time as rr_date, rr_distance, rr_topspeed, rr_avgspeed, rr_high, rr_gpx, cast(coalesce(rr_open, '0') as unsigned) as rr_open, coalesce(rr__breaktime, 0) as rr_breaktime, coalesce(rr_duration_sec, 0) as rr_time, rr_area, rr_name,
from riding_record where rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR) and cast(coalesce(rr_open, '0') as unsigned) = 1
mapper.update: update riding_record set rr_weather_observed_at = #{w.observedAtTimestamp}, rr_weather_nx = #{w.nx}, rr_weather_ny = #{w.ny}, rr_weather_temperature_c = #{w.temperatureC}, rr_weather_sky_code = #{w.skyCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, rr_weather_precipitation_code = #{w.precipitationCode}, rr_weather_precipitation_mm = #{w.precipitationMm,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, rr_weather_label = #{w.label} where rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR) and rr_weather_observed_at is null
update riding_record set rr_memo = #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where rr_rider = #{rr_rider} and rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR)
mapper.select: select count(*) from riding_record_photo where rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR)
select coalesce(max(sort_order), -1) + 1 from riding_record_photo where rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR)
mapper.insert: insert into riding_record_photo (photo_id, rr_idx, file_name, sort_order) values (#{id}, CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR), #{file}, #{order})
mapper.select: select photo_id as id, sort_order as sortOrder from riding_record_photo where rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR) order by sort_order, created_at

select p.file_name as fileName, r.rr_rider as ownerId, cast(coalesce(r.rr_open, '0') as unsigned) = 1 as publicRecord from riding_record_photo p join riding_record r on r.rr_idx = p.rr_idx where p.photo_id = #{id}
select file_name from riding_record_photo where photo_id = #{id} and rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR)
mapper.delete: delete from riding_record_photo where photo_id = #{id} and rr_idx = CAST(#{rr_num} AS CHAR)
mapper.update: update riding_record set rr_open = #{rr_open} where rr_idx = #{rr_num}
mapper.select: select riding_record.*,rider.r_image from riding_record, rider where rr_open= '1' and rider.R_ID = riding_record.RR_RIDER order by rr_date desc
select * from riding_record where rr_num = #{c_num}
insert into scrap_status (ss_rider, ss_rnum) values ( #{ss_rider}, #{ss_rnum} )
select rr_num, rr_like, rr_rider from riding_record inner join like_status on(like_status.ls_rnum=riding_record.rr_num and like_status.ls_rider=#{rr_rider})
select * from like_status where ls_rider=#{ls_rider} and ls_rnum=#{ls_rnum}

select ss_rider, rr_rider, rr_date, rr_name, ss_rnum, rr_avgspeed, rr_distance, rr_high, rr_time, rr_area, rr_gpx from riding_record INNER JOIN scrap_status ON(scrap_status.ss_rnum = riding_record.rr_num and scrap_status.SS_RIDER=#{ss_rider}) order by rr_gpx desc
select * from riding_record where rr_num = #{ss_rnum}
select * from riding_record order by rr_num desc
select * from riding_record where rr_num = #{rr_num}

select competition.COMP_NUM, competition.COMP_NAME, competition.COMP_NAME, competition.COMP_BADGE, competition.COMP_CONTENT, competition.COMP_COURSE, competition.COMP_IMAGE, competition.COMP_PERIOD, course.C_GPX , course.c_name from competition, course where comp_course = c_num order by comp_num
select rr_comp from riding_record where rr_rider = #{rr_rider} and rr_comp is not null order by rr_comp
select c_gpx from course where c_num = #{c_num}
select cs_club, cs_score, cb_name, cb_image from competition_status, club where cs_club = cb_num and cs_comp = #{cs_comp} order by cs_score desc
select * from dangerous_area
select * from badge where bg_num = #{comp_badge}
select rr_avgspeed, R_NICKNAME, R_IMAGE from riding_record, rider where RR_RIDER = R_ID and RR_COMP = #{comp_num} order by r_nickname
update competition_status set cs_rank = #{rank} where cs_comp = #{rr_comp} and cs_club = #{r_club}
select ms_score, ms_type from mission_status where ms_rider = #{LoginId} order by ms_type
select distinct m_num, m_content, m_type, m_name from mission, mission_complete where m_num not in ( select mc_mission from mission_complete where mc_rider = #{LoginIn} )
insert into mission_complete ( mc_num, mc_rider, mc_mission, mc_time ) values ( SQU_MISSIONCOM.nextval, #{LoginId}, #{mc_mission}, #{mc_time} )
select * from (select * from riding_record order by rr_num desc) where rownum <=1

select mission.*, badge.BG_IMAGE, badge.bg_name, ms.MS_SCORE from mission, badge, mission_status ms where badge.bg_num = mission.m_badge and m_type = ms.MS_TYPE and ms.MS_RIDER = #{LoginId} union select m.*, badge.bg_image, badge.bg_name, m.M_TYPE from mission m, badge where m_type = '4' and m.M_BADGE = badge.BG_NUM
select MC_mission from mission_complete where mc_rider = #{LoginId}
select mc_rider, r_nickname, r_image, count(*) as how from mission_complete, rider where mc_rider = rider.R_ID group by mc_rider, r_nickname, r_image order by how desc
select course_riview.*, r_nickname, r_image from course_riview, rider where cr_rnum = #{c_num} and r_id = cr_rider order by cr_time desc
select count(*) from rider where r_id = #{LoginId}

update riding_record set rr_name = rr_name+1 where rr_name=#{rr_foname}
